Makes Revolution is the debut studio album by T.M. Revolution. The album was released on August 12, 1996, under Antinos Records. It peaked at number 20 on the Oricon weekly album ranking, and appeared there for 31 weeks. It includes the two previous singles,  and . Makes Revolution was certified gold  in November 1997 by the Recording Industry Association of Japan.
